targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS "time", SUM(energy_kwh) AS "kWh" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT window_start AS "time", MAX(peak_power_w) / 1000.0 AS "peak_kW" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT window_start AS "time", SUM(samples) AS "samples" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT window_start AS "time", AVG(avg_pf) AS "avg_pf" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Homes by Energy (kWh) in Time Range

targets.rawSql: SELECT home_id, SUM(energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Plugs by Energy (kWh) in Time Range

targets.rawSql: SELECT home_id, plug_id, SUM(energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
